display_name: Neumann KU100 far-field 3.25 m (TH Koeln, Bernschuetz)
head: Neumann KU100

source.dataset: Spherical Far-Field HRIR Compilation of the Neumann KU100 (TH Koeln)
source.paper: B. Bernschuetz, 'A Spherical Far Field HRIR/HRTF Compilation of the Neumann KU 100', Proc. DAGA 2013, pp. 592-595

licence.notice: Benjamin Bernschuetz, TH Koeln. CC BY-SA 3.0.
licence.note: Zenodo metadata says CC BY 3.0; the SOFA file License attribute and the DAGA paper say CC BY-SA 3.0. Stricter reading (BY-SA) applied.
licence.changes: Derived by the 2011 Room Reverb project: diffuse-field equalised, 1/6-octave smoothed, left/right mirror-averaged magnitude at grid nodes, fitted to RBJ biquads; ITD modelled (Woodworth fit). No raw HRIRs redistributed.

measurement.sofa_history: Converted from the miro file format

ear_spacing_source: SOFA ReceiverPosition (|L - R|), VERIFIED from file
coords: head-relative, SOFA convention: azimuth deg counter-clockwise from front (+90 = LEFT), elevation deg up (+90 = top). Engine mapping: see BINAURAL_MODE_BRIEF.md section 3.

processing.eq: diffuse_field (power average over the measured sphere, area-weighted, 1/3-oct smoothed, both ears)
processing.symmetrised: L(n) := power mean of L(n) and R(mirror n); R(n) := L(mirror n)

itd.table_note: median measured LF ITD per 5-degree lateral bin (|el| <= 60), antisymmetrised
itd.correction_note: D(theta) = table_itd - (ear_spacing_m / c_engine) * sin(theta) in us; linear interpolation in theta
itd.engine_rule: per image, per tap build: D = correction(theta_lat); t_R += max(D, 0); t_L += max(-D, 0) (on top of each ear's own geometric path delay; contralateral ear only, so causal)
itd.method: LF cross-correlation (4th-order LP 1.5 kHz, x8 upsampled, +-1 ms); onset = -20 dB threshold, reported for comparison

ild: carried by the per-ear magnitude tables (no separate ILD gain)
notes: Binaural mode only. The capsule pattern gain is replaced by this colour (omni gain). Not a capsule preset: do not list in the per-capsule mic preset dropdown.
